goal: Real DevTools-equivalent request queries, headers, payloads and response bodies; approved internal API call/replay in the logged-in browser context; explicit multiple existing/future tabs across CLI, MCP stdio/HTTP and OMP.
parent_role: Initial primary research completed; PM, architect and reviewer only. Owning workers implement and repair.
git_owner: NetworkDocs exclusively stages exact approved owned paths, commits feature-sized milestones and pushes origin/main serially; never git add ., force/reset or unrelated paths.

contracts.capture: Passive page-scoped listeners before interaction; immutable capture-generation request IDs; detail/body field selection and byte-offset chunking with explicit unavailable/loss metadata. Private raw replay source is not implicitly exported.
contracts.privacy: Sanitized ordinary query/header/structured body data by default; include_sensitive requires explicit caller flag plus BROWSER_NETWORK_SENSITIVE=1 host consent; best-effort redaction is not a secrecy guarantee.
contracts.execution: Existing page.context.request cookie jar, provenance browser_context_api_request, never claimed page fetch/CORS or page Network event. Any authorized HTTP(S) URL/method; Surface automatically executes same-origin GET/HEAD/OPTIONS without body, explicit credential edits or consequential-looking path/query. Other plans require exact host approval; host BROWSER_NETWORK_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=1 requires approval for all calls. No automatic retries or cross-origin captured credential forwarding.
contracts.approval: prepare_only allows inspection without dispatch. Private engine derives safety; caller cannot approve itself. network_execute consumes expiring one-use exact plan approval bound session/tab/source/destination/method/body digest. Safe-read foreign-origin redirects return redirect_reapproval_required without contacting new origin. HTTP safe semantics and naming heuristics are not a guarantee that a server implements GET safely. Cancelled dispatched outcomes may be unknown; no automatic replay.
contracts.multi_tab: Explicit existing tabs and opt-in future pages/popups; per-tab captures/cursors/errors and protected URL checks, no single-tab cage or browser-wide completeness claim.
contracts.resources: Bounded configurable request/body storage and inbound/outbound sizes; transparent loss and APIResponse disposal on eviction/close. Protected local URLs, native consent, authentication and permissions remain enforced.

lifecycle.phase: NetworkDocs documentation READY: guide/schema/privacy/multi-tab/approval/research aligned with capture and Surface owner contracts; implementation workers still own their readiness and parent coordinates verification
lifecycle.ready_gate: All workers READY, then parent authorizes coordinated scoped checks. No worker tests/build/lint/format/smoke mid-flight.
lifecycle.release_gate: After stable scoped PASS parent authorizes final full suite/build and clean installed-wheel real browser plus official SDK stdio/current+legacy HTTP, CLI and actual OMP consumers; parent independently opens rendered output/screenshots.
lifecycle.compaction: Re-read AGENTS.md, agents/workstreams.json, this tracker, owning state and changed owned source; persist contracts/ownership/blockers, never trust chat memory alone.

evidence.new_feature_checks: Not yet authorized or executed; prior 152-test release evidence is historical, not proof of this feature.
evidence.credentials: No paid model credentials or personal native profile; disposable cookie-authenticated Chromium fixtures do not prove a real user's account.
